scientific_role: Topology-aware analytic certification from already-fixed I1 provider cards, without reconstructing hidden provider distributions or changing A_i.

allowed: exogenous global admissibility query A_G and rho_G
deterministic fixed-stage and network boundary terms

global_query_relation: Compose the already-fixed local A_i boundaries forward through G. The resulting sufficient boundary A_G_M0 certifies an exogenous A_G only when A_G_M0 is contained in A_G: l_M0<=l_G, c_M0<=c_G, q_M0>=q_G.

rho_allocation.rationale: If the same required root requests are aligned across local and global accounting, the union of local violation sets has fraction at most sum_i epsilon_i<=epsilon_G.

probability_composition.interpretation: lower-bound/certification probability, not an unbiased point estimate

hard_preconditions_for_numeric_certifica: forward-composed fixed A_i boundary is contained in the requested A_G
local and global cumulative accounting refer to aligned required root-request populations at the evaluated horizon
required local trajectory-level SLA events are independent for the anchor product rule
requested rho_i and H points exist in the frozen I1 cards
failure_semantics: If a hard precondition is not established, M0 reports that the fixed I1 information cannot certify that global query; Phase 2 is not reopened.
evaluation_lock: The structural contract is frozen before M0 is compared with any Phase-1 white-box sigma outcome.
